area_parameters: copy parent three-owner area_models exactly; no NNLS area refit
immutable_paths: copy all other six non-birth parent bounds at every exact clock; no calibration or reserve change
fitting_rows: 324 measured train/validation banks: old162 plus new162; same-source clocks/stages in one split; no consumed or fresh independent numeric labels
target: H_ps+delay_ps of each control path, per physical stage
baseline: global train maximum required control time plus original50ps, pooling only nine registered exact clocks
NNLS: unweighted train-only nonnegative least squares on protocol control_features; one is the declared constant feature; optional nine exact-clock indicators; no interpolation
upper_correction: max(0,max train required-regression_prediction), independent of validation and test
validation: all old/new rows covered for both mutable controls; original area20%/50% checked combined and each source cohort; unchanged six paths must cover all validation rows
selection: one complete two-control candidate per stage; passing validation first, mean predicted validation upper bound, compact serialized model bytes, declared order; no selectable model if none passes
